results.name: Disease-anchored causal pathway module

MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (object)-[:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]-(process)
MATCH (other_gene:Gene)-[:CAUSES]->(object)
MATCH (other_gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)

  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'

WITH subject, object, evidence, collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object, evidence,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,

         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated

WHERE size(binding_sources) >= 3
  AND evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 3
